## Recent experience

- Warp Laboratory, Inc. — Co-founder and Chief Product Officer (Mar 2026 — present). Product strategy and execution for Droplet, with no data leaving customers' premises. Three-year lease offering and customer pilots in photo, automotive, and real estate.
- Capital Group — Senior Full Stack Engineer, contract (Feb 2026 — Apr 2026). Internal Applications Portal: DevOps improvements, disaster recovery planning, and authentication migration to NerveCenter.
- Amazon — Software Development Engineer II, Private Brands, Marketing & Discoverability (Oct 2024 — Mar 2026). Distributed agent workflows, ML-driven experiments, and privacy governance. Workflow automation reclaimed 4+ hours of product manager time per week.
- Kanopy — Software Engineer I (Feb 2021 — Nov 2024). 98% supplier-file ingestion success; ECS upgrades reduced post-release errors from 2,000+ per day to near zero; title publication throughput increased by 150% year over year.
